prose: Bloomberg reports Upwind Security, a San Francisco startup offering cybersecurity for AI and cloud applications, raised $400 million led by Bessemer at a $3.8 billion valuation - up from $1.5 billion in January - bringing total funding to $830 million.
highlights: Upwind Security: $400M round led by Bessemer
